decisions.user_answer: 单列元数据，保留信息，同时让正文更纯净
decisions.scope: A separately extracted main title exists and an explicit 原标题： field appears near the article start. Quoted discussion of original titles elsewhere is not automatically metadata.

decisions.user_answer: 应判断为图说信息已保留，但类型应细化为 caption，图说信息也有一定重要性，先保证图说文字不丢、顺序正确，再考虑分类
decisions.scope: Require structural caption evidence or review; do not classify any text mentioning 截图 or 摄 as a caption by keyword alone.

rubric_impact.Q3: Existing caption text and relations retained is not caption omission merely because kind=paragraph. Type precision is a separate diagnostic.
rubric_impact.Q4: An explicit original-title field is metadata, not readable body under this task policy.
rubric_impact.historical_scores: Keep frozen old scores. A new output requires its own review, not an automatically improved score.

implementation_scope: Versioned postprocessing demonstration on four exposed historical candidates, not a new production extractor or generalization test.
